Hawaii has enacted 6 AI-related laws. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Hawaii

6 laws this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • HB2137: Relating To Artificial Intelligence. passed 2026-07-14

    This Act prohibits a person from knowingly publishing a realistic digital imitation of an identifiable individual without that individual's consent if the imitation is used in an advertisement, causes harm, or is used to commit fraud, defamation, harassment, or other criminal acts. It provides exemptions for parody, satire, commentary, criticism, scholarship, political or educational expression, news reporting, and certain documentary or biographical works. It establishes civil remedies for injured individuals, including injunctive relief, monetary damages, punitive damages, and attorneys' fees, and allows the attorney general to seek equitable relief for widespread harm.

  • SB3001: Relating To Artificial Intelligence. passed 2026-07-14

    The Artificial Intelligence Disclosure and Safety Act requires operators of AI companions to disclose that users are interacting with artificial intelligence, adopt crisis response protocols for suicidal ideation or self harm, and implement protections for minor users, including restrictions on engagement rewards and sexual content. It also requires annual reports to the Department of Health beginning January 1, 2028, and makes violations unfair or deceptive acts or practices under section 480-2.

  • SCR184: Requesting The Hawaii Civil Rights Commission To Examine The Applicability Of Existing State Anti-discrimination Laws To Algorithmic And Automated Decision Systems. passed 2026-04-27

    This concurrent resolution requests the Hawaii Civil Rights Commission to examine whether existing state anti-discrimination laws apply to algorithmic and automated decision systems. It asks the Commission to assess legal authority, identify challenges, evaluate guidance, consider a complaint pathway, and recommend legislation. It requests a report to the Legislature by twenty days before the 2027 Regular Session.

  • HR182: Requesting The Hawaii Civil Rights Commission To Examine The Applicability Of Existing State Anti-discrimination Laws To Algorithmic And Automated Decision Systems. passed 2026-04-09

    Requests the Hawaii Civil Rights Commission to examine whether existing state anti-discrimination laws apply to algorithmic and automated decision systems, and to report findings and recommendations to the Legislature by twenty days before the 2027 Regular Session.

  • SR165: Requesting The Hawaii Civil Rights Commission To Examine The Applicability Of Existing State Anti-discrimination Laws To Algorithmic And Automated Decision Systems. passed 2026-04-09

    The resolution requests the Hawaii Civil Rights Commission to examine whether existing state anti-discrimination laws apply to algorithmic and automated decision systems, and to report findings and recommendations to the Legislature by twenty days before the 2027 Regular Session. It does not create new legal obligations or prohibitions.

  • HR40: Urging The Department Of Education To Co-develop A Sixth To Twelfth Grade Artificial Intelligence Literacy And Usage Curriculum With Teachers. passed 2026-04-02

    Urges the Department of Education to co develop a sixth to twelfth grade artificial intelligence literacy and usage curriculum with teachers, and requests consultation of specified resources and design principles.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Hawaii. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
